explanation: The constitution of 1976 makes local government an elected power of the state rather than an arm of the administration. The freguesia, the município and the region are autarquias locais with organs of their own, chosen by their own voters. The Estado Novo had appointed the presidents of the chambers, and the revolutionary period had run municipalities through commissions named from the centre. The ballot of 12 December 1976 is the first use of that clause, and every local election the atlas holds after it descends from the clause.
